title: Cybercabs parked empty in a Tampa lot
title_candidates: 25 Tesla taxis with no steering wheel, no pedals, and no driver inside
What 25 of Tesla's driverless taxis look like sitting in the same lot
Tesla has 25 Cybercabs staged in Tampa and the launch is in two days
The moment you realize there are already 25 driverless taxis in Florida
No steering wheel. No pedals. 25 of them in a Tampa parking lot.
caption:
Tesla has 25 Cybercabs sitting in a parking lot in Tampa, and the official launch date is September 3.

These vehicles have no steering wheel and no pedals. Nobody inside. The whole idea is that they don't need any of it. Tampa is one of the first cities where the robotaxi service rolls out, and this footage shows what a starting fleet actually looks like before it hits the streets.

A year ago this was a render. Now there are 25 of them in a lot.
